claims.natural_statement: The preserved char-p-intersection draft supports the exact intersection proposition, including a common nonzero exponent and uniqueness from either single inclusion, and its formal source also removes ambient finiteness. This assessment reuses historical source-bound kernel evidence rather than claiming a new compiler run or novelty.

The preserved char-p-line-recovery draft supports unique scalar line recovery for the actual multiplicative and Steinberg quotients of characteristic-p fields of finite p-rank at least two, conditional on its unchanged reviewed intersection dependency. The manuscript function-field specialization must be assessed separately from the exact formal theorem.

Neither inventoried local proof unit certifies the full function-field reconstruction theorem: semilinear projective lifting, multiplicative normalization and the perfect-core argument remain outside the supplied formal certificates. This is a scope limitation, not a counterexample to the manuscript.

The old-draft review accounts for all 35 inventoried artifacts, all 18 versions of 15 ledger claims, all 13 evidence entries, three contexts and four historical routes in two substantive mathematical units; imported and duplicate material is not counted as new contributions.

For F0=kappa(t1,...,td) and q=[F:F0], Frobenius gives [F^p:F0^p]=q and tower degrees give q*p^d=[F:F^p]*q, so cancellation proves the assertion without separability. This supplies the manuscript specialization but is not formalized in prop_lines_source.
